rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=1, pretrain_steps=20, n_iter=30, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=5, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=0.5, proj_sr=0.02, img_kernel=7, img_sx=1.5, img_sy=1.5, img_sr=0.02, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1050, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=iter-8 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB: proj_sy 2.0 -> 0.5 (projection-domain bilateral SPATIAL sigma along the larger axis; 4x tighter angular/detector-row smoothing footprint). OFF iter-1 base (best-PSNR config: lr 5e-3, img_n_bf 1, proj_n_bf 1, proj_sr 0.02, proj_kernel 5 -- the untouched warm-start-anchored baseline; proj_n_bf REVERTED from iter-7 s 3 to 1 so this is genuinely ONE knob vs iter-1). PER-IMAGE preserved (warm-start amortized pre-pass on 4 train patients -> generic BF-sigma init, then INDEPENDENT per-scan Adam fit on EACH L277 slice OWN half-angle measurements, GT-free; NEVER amortized; warm_start=True, grad_clip=1.0 MANDATORY). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY: iter-1 lr5e-3 proj_sr0.02 proj_n_bf1 proj_kernel5 -> SSIM 0.92477 / PSNR 34.033 / RMSE 9.938e-4 / hr 0 / 940.4s; iter-2 proj_sr0.02->0.0005 -> SSIM 0.92473 / hr 0 (proj_sr range INERT, RETIRED); iter-3 lr5e-3->3e-4 -> SSIM 0.92142 / hr 0 (lr-down REGRESSED); iter-4 img_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.89748 / hr 0 (image-domain depth REGRESSED hard); iter-5 proj_n_bf1->2 -> SSIM 0.92468 / hr 0 (proj-depth +1 mild regress); iter-6 proj_kernel5->7 -> SSIM 0.924766 / hr 0 (proj spatial FOOTPRINT-EXTENT flat); iter-7 proj_n_bf1->3 -> SSIM 0.925289 / PSNR 34.097 / RMSE 9.865e-4 / hr 0 / 1129.1s (marginal best, proj-depth saturated). Best hr 0.0 throughout. (2) LIMITER = 6-param trainable-bilateral CAPACITY CEILING on dense-view 2304-view Mayo: HIGHEST raw SSIM of any Mayo inference solver (0.925) yet PSNR sits BELOW the LD-FBP floor -> hr 0 (over-smoothing signature). Confirmed-dead: proj_sr range (inert iter-2), per-scan lr-down (regressed iter-3), img_n_bf depth (regressed iter-4), proj_n_bf depth (flat-to-marginal iters 5/7), proj_kernel footprint-extent (flat iter-6). (3) ONE KNOB = proj_sy 2.0->0.5: the proj-domain bilateral has THREE shape controls -- range sigma proj_sr (tested INERT), kernel footprint-EXTENT proj_kernel (tested FLAT), and the SPATIAL sigma proj_sx/proj_sy (the per-axis Gaussian WEIGHTING inside that footprint) -- which is GENUINELY UNTRIED. proj_sy=2.0 is the larger axis (the angular/detector-row direction); tightening it 4x to 0.5 sharpens the proj-domain spatial weighting on the established Mayo lever-SIDE (proj, per campaign-state line 212: image-domain sigma is inert, proj is the Mayo bilateral lever-side). A tighter spatial sigma weights the central detector samples more, potentially preserving attenuation-edge sharpness across the dense 2304-view sinogram that the loose proj_sy=2.0 blurs. (4) HYPOTHESIS: tightening the proj-domain spatial sigma proj_sy preserves projection-edge sharpness -> RMSE drops -> PSNR clears the LD-FBP floor -> hr rises above 0 (predict hr ~0.0-0.05). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr stays 0 (SSIM <= 0.9253, PSNR <= 34.10, no RMSE drop below 9.86e-4) at proj_sy=0.5, then the proj-domain SPATIAL sigma is ALSO exhausted and ALL of the proj-domain bilateral shape controls (range proj_sr, footprint proj_kernel, depth proj_n_bf, spatial proj_sy) are mapped-and-dead -- the trainable-bilateral N2I is STRUCTURALLY CAPPED on dense-view Mayo regardless of any proj-domain knob, structural-ceiling verdict FILED toward the iter-20 confirmation: only the U-Net N2I real-denoiser capacity clears the FBP floor here (half-view N2I info loss < full-view LD-FBP); hr 0 / SSIM ~0.925 stands as the documented 6-param bilateral N2I ceiling on dense Mayo. (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min = 1200s train+score): proj_sy is a SIGMA-INIT knob -- kernel/n_iter=30/214-scans/2304-view FBP-adjoint cost ALL UNCHANGED; proj_n_bf reverted 3->1 so this is the CHEAP 1-proj-layer config (iter-1 ran 940.4s = 15.7 min, NOT iter-7 s 1129.1s at proj_n_bf=3). Expect ~940s = ~15.7 min, ~260s slack inside 1200s -- ZERO budget risk. val=ALL 214, grad_clip=1.0 MANDATORY, lr/img_n_bf/proj_sr/proj_kernel/proj_n_bf all at iter-1 values. in-solver outer_wall_s=1050 (17.5 min) backstop GUARANTEES a recorded result even if some slices run long. (6) HARD 20-min budget; val=ALL 214 L277 slices (NOT reduced); PER-IMAGE preserved (warm_start True, grad_clip 1.0, img_sr 0.02 NOT tightened). Do NOT return control mid-campaign. PREDICTED iter-8: hr ~0.0-0.05 if proj-spatial-sigma capacity helps; hr<=0 falsifies (bilateral structurally capped on dense Mayo regardless of proj-domain knob, 6-param bilateral N2I ceiling confirmed, only U-Net N2I works).
